title: Fixing an already matched list
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\eta$ assign a restriction state to each of the $n$ coordinates, let $L$ be a list of coordinates, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. If at every coordinate in $L$, $\eta$ already equals the fixed state determined by the sign encoded by $x_i$, then fixing the coordinates in $L$ according to $x$ leaves $\eta$ unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: At every coordinate in $L$, $\eta$ equals the fixed state determined by the sign encoded by $x_i$
